Publish.LongDescription:
## Adjust All Speed Limits ...and Paths and Invisible roads now too 🥳
自由调整全路网限速，隐形道路也能改！ 中文详情见下方 ↓
Is a powerful, easy toolkit to fine-tune how fast vehicles travel on any network type.
Open ASL, then click a road or any network to open the full panel.
## 🌄 Key Features
* **Adjust speeds on individual segments** with a simple click. * **Click-and-drag** over the road/track to modify multiple segments at once. * Works on: * 🚗 **Roads** 🚊 **Trams** 🚆 **Trains** 🚇 **Subway** ⛵ **Waterways** 🚲 **New: Bike paths** * 👁 **New: Invisible networks** — see/edit invisible hidden roads and bike paths. Optional hotkey works even with the panel closed. * **Personal vehicle status:** Bike, scooter, car and parked counts. Hidden-car diagnostic report. Updates in Options only. * **New Paths tab:** separate global speed-limit scales for Bike + mixed paths and Pedestrian-only paths, 30–300% (100% = vanilla). Individual bike-path edits take priority. * Stats are light: only runs when the panel is open, better data than the game's info panel.
### Bonus Features
- **Paths tab:** Adjust bicycle and pedestrian path limits citywide. - **Options menu:** optional bicycle/scooter vehicle speeds, plus some statistics.
## Important
* Remove old "Road Speed Adjuster" (RSA) mod before installing this (modder retired). * Existing custom speeds should remain and can be edited/reset per segment in new mod. * Pedestrian-only paths can be adjusted globally (not per segment). This changes path limits, not citizen max walking speed. * Remove Bikes + Paths mod (retired) when using ASL; no reset is required. * Vehicles are limited by their model type max speeds as well. This mod is for the Networks themselves, but in Options you can adjust Bicycle vehicles. * Removing this mod does not reset your customized speed limits. Any speeds you set will remain on the section until you delete/change the road. * **Use Reset buttons** and then Save City to restore the roads/segments to default speeds. * Lightweight: stats only runs while ASL is open. Global path changes apply on request or city load only, then go idle. * ICE-3 trains have a real top speed of 320km/h, so the rail slider allows up to 400km/h (800km/h with doubled display). * The game's Unlimited highway policy is 200km/h normally, or 400km/h with "Show Game Doubled Speeds".
## Support and Feedback * Support by clicking the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. It takes weeks and months to make these level of mods and many hours with testers. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [Github](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-AllSpeedLimits) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
## ❤️ Credits and Special Thanks Huge appreciation hugs and waves to everyone
* River-mochi: mod author * Chaosfun: testing and [video of older version](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qADctjYS5-w) before Invisible roads and paths were added. * Sunny Scunny, Maestro, Gagaxm, Obelix: testing and feedback. * yenayang: technical advisor * Thanks to everyone who tested, supported, or guided development along the way! * Thumbnail photo: Toronto, Canada by [Alex Smith free use Unsplash license](https://unsplash.com/photos/time-lapse-photography-of-vehicles-in-busy-road-sRTLpqB5haw) * Thumbnail: [dog by Joe Caione, free use Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/shallow-focus-photography-of-white-shih-tzu-puppy-running-on-the-grass-qO-PIF84Vxg) * History and thanks to all past modders: SwiftCobra creator of the first speed mod (MIT license). It passed to Aberro's mod (MIT) and then to DanielVNZ's version (retired).

### 全路网限速调整
自由调整城市中各类道路和交通线路的限速！
打开 ASL，点击任意道路即可进入操作面板。支持简体中文界面和提示。
### 🌄 主要功能
- **单击选择路段，拖动批量选择。** 轻松修改限速。 - 🚗 **道路** 🚊 **有轨电车** 🚆 **铁路** 🚇 **地铁** ⛵ **航道** 🚲 **自行车道** - 👁 **隐形道路：** 显示并修改隐藏道路和自行车道，支持快捷键，无需打开面板。 - 🚲 **自行车和电动滑板车：** 在游戏选项中调整车辆最高速度（30–1000%），自动调整加速和刹车。默认关闭，避免与其他车辆速度模组冲突。 - **全城路径限速：** 分别调整自行车道、混合路径和纯人行道的限速（30–300%）。单独修改的路段优先。 - **交通统计：** 查看车辆数量、行驶及停放情况。
**100% = 游戏默认值。**
### 使用须知
- 请先卸载旧版 Road Speed Adjuster（RSA）。 - **Bikes + Paths 已停止维护，功能已整合至 ASL。** 可直接卸载旧模组，无需重置。 - 如想先恢复原版速度，可单独使用 B+P 的恢复默认值功能，然后保存城市。此步骤非必需。 - 纯人行道仅支持全城调整，不改变市民实际步行速度。 - 车辆实际速度仍受车型最高速度限制。 - **可安全卸载。** 已修改的路段限速会保留。如需恢复原版限速，请使用重置按钮并保存城市。 - **轻量高效：** 统计仅在面板打开时运行，路径限速调整完成后即休眠。
### ❤️ 支持与反馈
喜欢这个模组？欢迎点击右上角的 👍 点赞支持！
免费分享，无需捐款。
